messages:
alex.docs: Quick q - updating SOC2 retention doc to include a short section on cross-region backups and the new 'presets' names. Also found the Python SDK audit export snippet link is broken. Can legal and eng weigh in?

nina.legal: Keep wording cautious. Suggest: "Audit logs are retained according to tenant-configured retention settings. If copies are created in other regions (e.g., for disaster recovery), those copies are subject to the same retention and access controls and adhere to the customer's key management policies."

sam.eng: Tech note: replicas are only created for DR for tenants without strict residency flags. Replicas inherit the original TTL metadata; KMS re-encryption happens on cross-region copy using customer CMK when provided.

alex.docs: Thanks. Draft bullets: - Preset 'short' = 30 days, stored in-region by default. - Preset 'standard' = 365 days, may have DR replicas; replicas expire per original TTL. Also add a note: contact sales for strict residency/private deployments.

nina.legal: LGTM, tiny edit: change "may have DR replicas" -> "may be replicated for DR purposes".

alex.docs: done. I'll open a PR and fix the Python link to point at the example in sdk-python/examples/audit_export.py.

ci-bot: PR opened by alex.docs  docs/retention: add cross-region backup guidance and update SDK snippet link (PR #1042)

sam.eng: I'll add a repo redirect for the old Python path. ETA EOD.

alex.docs: Thanks everyone, closing thread after merge.
